title: Void Crystal Orb
text: Forge a crystal orb, liquid crystal orb, darkness microcore and eye of ender in any arrangement on the assembly table.

The central trash slot and item/fluid ports immediately destroy all input. There is no temporary storage or undo. Resonance nodes and pipes can insert, but nothing can be extracted. A terminal-bound node turns black and is named Void; unbound nodes remain red.
The base has one central upgrade socket, accepting only intake upgrades. Intake follows the configured directions and filters; direct input and resonance transfer bypass that filter.
Shattering a Void Crystal Orb by stepping on it is risky.
